verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API and MCP server allow programmatic management of connectors, including copying existing connections to new destinations and read/write/delete operations at scale, which supports some multi-item automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of true bulk operations (e.g., batch create/update/delete across many items in a single call) beyond individual connector-level actions. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, evidence of processing many items in one operation, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows working at scale.
